items.headline: Update: PM Wong joins APEC leaders in Shenzhen, set for bilateral with Xi
items.summary: PM Wong is at the 33rd APEC meeting in Shenzhen and due to meet Xi Jinping on Nov 20.

items.headline: Singapore starts taking down ERP gantries in shift to satellite road pricing
items.summary: LTA has begun removing ERP gantries; 62 of 95 offline, works to finish by June 2027 as satellite ERP starts Jan 1 2027.

items.headline: Man given 12 years' preventive detention for exploiting a 14-year-old girl
items.summary: A 39-year-old man received 12 years' preventive detention for sexually exploiting a 14-year-old girl.

items.headline: Domestic worker pleads guilty to abusing her employer's baby
items.summary: A 24-year-old domestic worker pleaded guilty to abusing her employer's infant.

items.headline: Update: India says US trade deal is nearly ready but signing awaits a new tariff framework
items.summary: Commerce Secy Agrawal says deal largely finalised but signing waits on a new US tariff framework and Section 301 probes.

items.headline: India's Sensex rebounds 990 points as the bank index closes at a record
items.summary: Sensex +989.94 to 83,021.75, Nifty +286.35 to 25,514.30, Nifty Bank record 63,063, autos lead.

items.headline: India-UK ties hold firm despite Modi's 'decolonisation' rhetoric
items.summary: Analysis of Prince William's India visit: trade and strategic ties deepen despite Modi's anti-colonial rhetoric.

items.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin hold a first-ever trilateral and issue a 'peace declaration'
items.summary: First-ever three-way talks at APEC Shenzhen; declaration reaffirms 'nuclear war cannot be won', no timetable or stockpile cuts.

items.headline: UN's top court rules Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
items.summary: ICJ found 9-6 that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, first time it held a state responsible for genocide.

items.headline: Update: Israel's push across Gaza's 'Yellow Line' deepens the enclave's aid crisis
items.summary: Gaza health ministry says 1,658 killed since Oct 2025 ceasefire; ~100,000 aid tents stuck at closed crossings.

items.headline: Nvidia halts shipments of its licensed Hopper AI chips to China
items.summary: Interim CEO Kress says Nvidia no longer ships licensed Hopper/H200 chips to China; $2.4B of sales excluded from guidance.

items.headline: Anthropic's record Nasdaq debut closes up 17%, enriching backers Amazon and Google
items.summary: Anthropic (ANT) opened $111.50 (+34%), closed $97.17 (+17%), ~$1.76T valuation; Amazon and Google hold ~28%.

items.headline: Wall Street falls again as Anthropic's debut fails to revive the AI trade
items.summary: S&P 500 -2.02% to 7,175.83, Nasdaq -2.25% to 23,879.20, Dow off more than 1,000 points on Nov 19.

items.headline: Oil rebounds after a sharp selloff while gold sinks near a one-year low
items.summary: Brent +0.8% to $92.72, WTI +1.3% to $84.34 after prior day's ~3% drop; gold at about a one-year low.

items.headline: Shelton beats Jodar to reach his first ATP Finals semifinal
items.summary: Ben Shelton beat Rafael Jodar 7-6(8), 7-5 in Turin to reach his first ATP Finals semifinal, second in his group behind Zverev.

items.headline: Update: Nicholls' unbeaten 113 lifts New Zealand to 243-5 against India
items.summary: Day 1 at Wellington: NZ recovered from 70-5; Nicholls 113*, Phillips 94* in an unbroken 173 stand; Bumrah 3-52.

items.headline: Piastri handed a 10-place Las Vegas grid penalty for a fifth engine
items.summary: Oscar Piastri drops 10 grid places at the Las Vegas GP after a fifth engine; 7th in standings, winless in 2026.

items.headline: Verstappen leads a five-way fight for runner-up as the Las Vegas GP opens
items.summary: Antonelli already champion; Las Vegas fight is for second: Verstappen 279, Russell 262, Hamilton 261.

items.headline: Webb data confirms a first-of-its-kind stellar merger in the Andromeda galaxy
items.summary: JWST confirmed a ~0.7-solar-mass star merged with a ~7-solar-mass supergiant in Andromeda ('Bao'); Nature, Nov 18.

items.headline: Fossil teeth show Homo erectus survived in southern China far later than thought
items.summary: Nine teeth from Guangxi caves dated 324,000-184,000 years ago suggest H. erectus persisted ~200,000 years longer; two Nature studies.

items.headline: ULA's Vulcan rocket failure could set back US national-security launches for years
items.summary: ULA's Vulcan suffered its first total failure Nov 15, destroying 40 Amazon Leo satellites; traced to inadequate first-stage fuel supply.

fun_fact.headline: Strawberries are not berries, but bananas are
fun_fact.body: Botanically a berry is a fleshy fruit from a single flower's ovary with seeds in the flesh, so bananas, grapes, tomatoes and avocados are berries; strawberries (accessory fruit) and raspberries (aggregate fruit) are not.

puzzle.title: Book Keeping
puzzle.body: A book's pages are numbered from 1. Printing all the page numbers took exactly 1,890 digits. How many pages does the book have?
puzzle.approach: Count digits in blocks: 1-digit, 2-digit and 3-digit pages.

word_puzzle.title: Four Corners
word_puzzle.body: Letter Boxed. Top=U A N, Right=R O I, Bottom=C D S, Left=L B T. Use all 12 letters in two words.
word_puzzle.approach: Chain two words covering all 12 letters; no two consecutive letters from the same side.
